title: Rangili Ramzat 7 (Garba)
artist: Kirtidan Gadhvi, Kajal Maheriya, Dharmesh Barot, Rashmita Rabari
label: Kirtidan Gadhvi
description: A 19-track 2025 Rangili Ramzat album credited to Kirtidan Gadhvi, Kajal Maheriya, Dharmesh Barot and Rashmita Rabari; the split album is the canonical song edition, while the separately published September 11 continuous 2 Taali master remains a distinct Nonstop listening set rather than a chapter source.
notes: The 19-track split album is canonical. The separately published September 11 continuous 2 Taali master is retained as a distinct Nonstop listening set and is not used as an inferred chapter source for these tracks.
